Apple 為歐盟應用程式開發者修訂商業條款

Apple 早前宣布調整歐洲地區的應用程式追蹤透明度功能，隨後在歐盟公佈了一套簡化的 App Store 佣金架構。以下是詳細內容。

Apple revamps EU business terms for app developers

Apple 近日宣布對歐洲地區的應用程式追蹤透明度功能作出八項調整，是次調整源於德國反壟斷監管機構的一項調查。

Now, the company has announced a new commission structure for the region that will take effect on October 1, including cutting its link-out commission to 15% and replacing the controversial Core Technology Fee with a 5% Core Technology Commission.

在 App Store 應用程式中以連結導向外站完成交易的，佣金率為 15%；上述計劃的開發者將可享較低的 10% 費率。

透過替代應用程式市集或網頁分發的應用程式，Apple 將收取 5% 的 Core Technology Commission。

Under the new terms, developers will also be able to offer Apple In-App Purchase alongside alternative payment options, either in-app or through links to the web, provided they follow Apple’s “presentation requirements” and maintain their chosen payment options for 12 months.

針對 13 歲以下用戶，App Store 上的應用程式不得以連結導向網站進行交易，以防止針對幼童的詐騙風險。

Apple 補充，在歐盟成員國中若法例要求對 13 歲以上兒童的數碼行為取得家長同意，有關保障將會相應調整。

Finally, Apple’s newly announced changes also expand eligibility to operate alternative app marketplaces or distribute apps via the web.

The expanded qualification terms include:

Apple 指出，目前僅在歐盟提供的網頁分發方式，由於缺乏市集營運商持續監管，不法分子可能「在被人發現之前長期運作，損害用戶權益」。

As a result, Apple says it will continue to require all apps distributed via alternative channels to go through its Notarization process.

如欲了解更多關於今次宣布的詳情，請按此連結。

Update: In a statement to Bloomberg, a European Commission spokesperson said the Commission welcomes Apple’s changes, noting that they follow a “close dialogue” with the company. They added that the Commission will monitor Apple’s implementation of the new terms.
